import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';const root=fs.realpathSync(fileURLToPath(new URL('.',import.meta.url)));assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(tmpdir()),root);for(const key of ['TMP','TEMP','TMPDIR'])assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(process.env[key]),root);fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root,'env-'+process.pid+'.json'),JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,tmpdir:tmpdir(),time:new Date().toISOString()}));
const receipt=path.join(root,'env-'+process.pid+'.json');function recordExit(code){const info=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(receipt,'utf8'));info.closed=new Date().toISOString();info.exitCode=code;fs.writeFileSync(receipt,JSON.stringify(info));}process.on('exit',recordExit);

shutdown-evidence-ledger.md.text:
# PF02-A shutdown measurement investigation

- Facts: version-query target improves >40%; all startup/cleanup functional assertions pass. Non-version input ACK controls are stable. No shutdown/terminal/runtime source was changed in PF02-A.
- Symptom: Windows bundled/fullscreen quit-to-close timing has variable baseline tails. Six-event per-group p95 equals the maximum. After retaining all data and collecting five independent 30-event windows, baseline p95 band is still 10.151%, candidate 5.802%. Window-p95 median is 100.627 -> 102.432 ms, while pooled 150-event p95 is 104.146 -> 101.678 ms. This does not demonstrate a reproducible product regression or improvement.
- Artifacts: task root `.task-tmp/pf02-version-IXcCi5`; original `cli-lifecycle-*`, all four `cli-stability-*` result/process files; `lifecycle-control.mjs`, `lifecycle-stability.mjs`, source/dist hashes in `docs/evidence/performance-pf02-version-2026-11-05.json`.
- Known-good comparison: exact pre-PF02 launcher/CLI snapshots with the same current unchanged dependencies; same fresh HOME, resources, 100ms settling delay, terminal adapter and paired order.
- Rejected explanation: sparse six-event quantiles alone explain all variance. Five 30-event windows still exceed 10%, so further identical sampling is not the next action.
- Remaining hypotheses: existing 50ms idle-input drain timer scheduling; UI/runtime release; OS exit/pipe-close delivery. These are hypotheses, not established root causes.
- Static evidence: performShutdown awaits `drainInput(1000)` with unchanged default idle=50ms, then `stop()`, then runtimeHost.dispose(), then process.exit. The first two are already supported by the PF00 diagnostic probe.
- Next one-question diagnostic: which unchanged shutdown phase contains the spread? Use only a task-owned explicit preload for drain/stop/runtime dispose plus parent observation of exit-marker/exit/close. The probe changes import order, so its startup numbers are not production timing evidence.
- Guardrails: user's performance/PR constraints remain in force. No new production patch, no lowered timeout, no shortened input drain, no skipped teardown, no removed slow sample, no timer/priority/system setting change. No shell other than explicit PowerShell 7. Remove task diagnostics by exact owned resource identity after archiving results.

limitations: Version-only improvement does not reduce default interactive startup; PF02-B remains independent.
Windows local tests skip seven native POSIX-signal cases; Linux CI is required.
No live provider, auth refresh, paid API request or real private transcript used.
No new cache/pool; process exit is the version-entry module ownership release boundary.

shutdownStability.interpretation: Six-event p95 is the sample maximum. Retain original exploratory grouping and all five 30-event windows. Baseline absolute p95 band remains 10.151%, not a passed <=10% stability gate. Each paired-window candidate p95 increase is below 5%, so no repeated regression blocker was observed. Explicit phase probe finds spread in the unchanged 50ms idle drain and runtime disposal on both arms; post-exit-marker interval is similar. Do not claim an absolute shutdown speedup or a stabilized absolute-time comparison. Carry that measurement limitation to PF07; PF02-A target and benefits concern standalone version queries only.
shutdownStability.probeLimit: Explicit preload changes module import order; its startup timing is not normal startup evidence. It observes existing waits/release calls; no production timer/deadline/cleanup change or OS priority/timer-resolution change was made.
